related.title: Apple Core ML：Neural Engine 與裝置駐留
related.titleEn: Apple Core ML: Neural Engine and device residency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：編譯報告和時間軸一致，CPU工作完整計時，改圖前後品質符合預定範圍。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compilation and timing agree, all CPU work is timed, and quality meets declared limits.
related.difference: 把允許使用某處理器與實際映射區分，對比核心時間及完整呼叫延遲。
related.differenceEn: Separate allowed processors from actual placement, and compare kernel time with complete call latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 串行推論延遲等於各分區執行時間與邊界傳輸之和；算子數沒有時間權重。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 TPU分區2 ms，CPU尾段12 ms，邊界複製1 ms；CPU尾段僅占兩個算子。 總延遲2+12+1=15 ms；CPU尾段占80%，不能因算子少而忽略。
總延遲等於各子圖時間加布局轉換及邊界成本；更快的子圖可能被額外轉換抵消。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 合成CPU-only耗時9 ms；混合路徑運算4 ms，三次邊界各2 ms。 混合路徑4+3×2=10 ms，比9 ms更慢；這不是任何Apple裝置實測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Serial latency sums partition execution and boundary transfers; operator counts have no timing weights. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. TPU partition2 ms, CPU tail12 ms, boundary copy1 ms; the CPU tail contains only two operators. Total 2+12+1=15 ms; the CPU tail contributes80% despite few operators.

Total latency includes subgraphs, layout conversions and boundaries; faster kernels can lose to added conversions. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Synthetic CPU-only time 9 ms; heterogeneous compute4 ms with three 2 ms boundaries. Heterogeneous time 4+3×2=10 ms, slower than9 ms; these are not Apple measurements.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Triton fused softmax：中間張量消除
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：編譯報告和時間軸一致，CPU工作完整計時，改圖前後品質符合預定範圍。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compilation and timing agree, all CPU work is timed, and quality meets declared limits.
related.difference: 列出每個中間張量的讀寫，驗證融合後數值穩定性與流量降低。
related.differenceEn: List reads/writes for intermediates, and verify stable numerical results after fusion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 串行推論延遲等於各分區執行時間與邊界傳輸之和；算子數沒有時間權重。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 TPU分區2 ms，CPU尾段12 ms，邊界複製1 ms；CPU尾段僅占兩個算子。 總延遲2+12+1=15 ms；CPU尾段占80%，不能因算子少而忽略。
未融合的max讀N、減值讀寫2N、exp讀寫2N、sum讀N、除法讀寫2N，共8Ns主張量bytes；融合只需2Ns，前提中間量留片上。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學N=2^20元素、s=4 bytes，只計完整主張量往返，較小的列統計陣列另外列出。 未融合主張量流量8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB；是逐算子物化模型，不代表所有softmax實作。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Serial latency sums partition execution and boundary transfers; operator counts have no timing weights. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. TPU partition2 ms, CPU tail12 ms, boundary copy1 ms; the CPU tail contains only two operators. Total 2+12+1=15 ms; the CPU tail contributes80% despite few operators.

Unfused max reads N, subtraction reads/writes2N, exp2N, sum reads N, and division2N:8Ns main-tensor bytes; fusion uses2Ns when intermediates stay on chip. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching N=2^20 elements, s=4 bytes, counting full main-tensor traffic and listing smaller row-statistic arrays separately. Unfused main-tensor traffic=8×2^20×4/2^20=32 MiB for materialized operators, not every softmax implementation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
